description_en: Creates a binding for an AXN Privacy Number. This process assigns a dedicated Privacy Number (the X Number) to User A, allowing any caller to connect to User A by dialing the X Number
description_zh: 添加AXN隐私号的绑定关系。AXN隐私号是为A用户分配一个专属的隐私号，任何号码N通过拨打X号码都可以转接到A
name: BindAxn

parameters.help_en:
The key of the Number Pool.

You can get the Pool Key from the Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m) page
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m)页面获取号码池Key
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en: Phone number A for the AXN binding. This can be a mobile phone number or a fixed-line phone. For a fixed-line phone, you must include the area code. Do not add a hyphen between the area code and the phone number
parameters.help_zh:
AXN隐私号的A号码。
A号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符
parameters.name: phone_noa

parameters.help_en:
Phone number B for the AXN binding.

This can be a mobile phone number or a fixed-line phone. For a fixed-line phone, you must include the area code. Do not add a hyphen between the area code and the phone number.

By default, calls from Phone number A to Phone number X are routed to Phone number B. If you do not specify Phone number B, the call fails to connect.

A call from Phone number A to Phone number X is routed to Phone number B only if Callback Mode for Number A is set to Default mode. Otherwise, the call fails to connect.

To change the Callback Mode for Number A, go to the Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?resType=1) page, filter for AXN Privacy Number, and then choose Pool Management > Callback Mode for Number A > Adjust Configuration.

To update Phone number B, call the UpdateSubscription (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-updatesubscription?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i11) API
parameters.help_zh:
AXN隐私号的B号码。

B号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符。
A号码拨打X号码时，默认会转接到B号码，如B号码未设置，则无法接通。
A号码拨打X号码时，A号码回拨模式为默认模式时，才会转接到B号码，若不是默认模式，则无法接通。
如需修改A号码回拨模式，在号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?resType=1)>筛选AXN隐私号>号池管理>A号码回拨模式>调整配置修改。
如需更新B号码，请调用UpdateSubscription (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-updatesubscription?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i11)接口更新
parameters.name: phone_nob

parameters.help_en:
Phone number X, the privacy number for the AXN binding.

Phone number X must be one of your Purchased Privacy Numbers (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m) in the console.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system randomly assigns a number from the number pool as Phone number X. The selection is based on the ExpectCity parameter
parameters.help_zh:
AXN隐私号的X号码。

X号码是您在控制台已购买的隐私号 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m)。

如果未指定X号码时，将根据参数ExpectCity从指定号码池中随机指定一个号码作为X号码
parameters.name: phone_nox

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time of the binding. The time must be in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format.

The expiration time must be at least 60 seconds in the future
parameters.help_zh:
绑定关系的过期时间，单位：秒。

必须晚于当前时间60秒以上
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en:
The city from which to select Phone number X.

If no numbers are available in the specified city or if you do not specify this parameter, the system randomly assigns a number from another city in the current number pool.

If Number X Allocation Mode is set to Strict Match Mode, the system returns an allocation error if it cannot find an eligible number
parameters.help_zh:
指定城市进行X号码的选号。

如果当前号码池中没有该城市的可用号码，或未指定此参数，将从当前号码池中随机分配一个其他城市的号码作为X号码。
如果X号码分配模式配置为严格匹配模式，当符合条件的号码不存在时，系统会提示分配错误
parameters.name: expect_city

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable call recording for this binding. Valid values:

true: Enables call recording.

false (default): Disables call recording
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要针对该绑定关系产生的所有通话录制通话录音。取值：

true：录音。
false：不录音（默认值）
parameters.name: is_recording_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The number type.

This parameter applies to legacy Alibaba Dayu customers. Current Alibaba Cloud users can ignore this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
号码类型。

适用于原阿里大于客户，阿里云用户可忽略
parameters.name: no_type

parameters.help_en: An external extension field that is included in the call detail record (CDR) callback
parameters.help_zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en:
Sets the caller ID display logic for the binding. The value must be 1, which indicates that the privacy number (Phone number X) is displayed to both the caller and the callee.

Due to carrier-side regulatory restrictions, settings that display real numbers are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
重置绑定关系中的号码显示逻辑。固定取值：1（主被叫显示中间号码X）。

由于运营商监管限制，呼叫时显示真实号码的设置不生效
parameters.name: call_display_type

parameters.help_en:
Configures the enterprise ring-back tone for calls to Phone number X.

This parameter requires a ringtone field and a ring-back tone code.

Valid values for the ringtone field:

The ring-back tone that plays before a call from Phone number A to Phone number X connects (with callback number): AXNRing_AB

The ring-back tone that plays before a call from Phone number A to Phone number X connects (without callback number): AXNRing_A

The ring-back tone that plays before a call from Phone number N to Phone number X connects: AXNRing_N

The in-call tone that plays after a call from Phone number A to Phone number X connects: AXNRing_A_PICKUP

The in-call tone that plays after a call from Phone number N to Phone number X connects: AXNRing_N_PICKUP

Ring-back tone code:

You can get the enterprise ring-back tone code from the Enterprise CRBT Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool/ringtone?resType=1) page.

Example format:

To set the ring-back tone for calls from Phone number A to Phone number X (without a callback number), use the following format: "AXNRing_A":"1000\\1".

The enterprise ring-back tone set at the binding level takes precedence. If a tone is not set at the binding level or the setting is invalid, the system uses the tone set at the number pool level
parameters.help_zh:
设置AXN隐私号在号码绑定后，拨打X号码的企业彩铃。

此参数请填写铃音字段和彩铃编码。

铃音字段取值：
AXN中，A号码打X接通前的铃音设置（有回拨号码）：AXNRing_AB
AXN中，A号码打X接通前的铃音设置（无回拨号码）：AXNRing_A
AXN中，N侧号码打X接通前的铃音设置：AXNRing_N
AXN中，A号码打X接通后的铃音设置：AXNRing_A_PICKUP
AXN中，N号码打X接通后的铃音设置：AXNRing_N_PICKUP

彩铃编码：

在号码隐私保护控制台企业彩铃管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool/ringtone?resType=1)页面获取企业彩铃编码。

填写示例：

如设置A号码拨打X接通前的铃音（无回拨号码），填写："AXNRing_A": "1000****1"。

企业彩铃优先使用绑定级别设置的彩铃，如果未设置或设置未生效，则会使用号码池级别的彩铃音
parameters.name: ring_config
